commits.body:
Run the pinned JDK properties reader on both original JAR streams. Only its private buffer can coalesce short reads, and the underlying cursor stays opaque on early exit. Follow Spring's real map updates and mapped implementation-name callbacks. Model one-shot soft-reference delivery, permanent clearing, captured reference choices and symbolic lock holds for the formatter's ResolvableType cache.

Both binder JVMs returned the exact factory property on 12,881 refill partitions each. On both formatter slices the retention and release controls passed and ten real converter registrations completed before EnumToStringConverter. A capped native proof covered the Spring soft cache. The ten-registration probe hit its 60-second limit. The two-factory companion records its own result. The changed test selection passed all 59 Rust binaries and the selected Python suites. The pinned JDK 21 regression tests and the 368 and 374 validators passed.

Managed jobs 20261123-064120-recheck-ordinary-spring-entries-after-fa, 20261123-064120-check-spring-factory-properties-and-soft and 20261123-064120-check-cache-stream-and-map-changes-again cover all four Spring examples, both deployment graphs and both proof-tier conformance tests.
